entryChooseWorkspace: Enter a workspace before using Chief.
entrySetupRequired: Open the workspace to finish setting up Chief and start its executor.
entryCheckFailed: Couldn't check Chief's status. Please try again.

stageAccess.title: Connect an executor
stageAccess.description: Chief needs an online executor to start. Click the button below and follow the steps to connect one.

strip.access: Pick the client and OS in this panel, then click “Generate and copy command”.
strip.wait: Waiting for the executor to come online; checked every 5 seconds.
strip.send: The initialization request is prefilled below. Review it and click Send.

completedToast: Guide complete. Chief has the setup; see the workspace.
tipAccess: If the workspace already has an executor, just bring it back online. The command only needs to run once on that machine.
tipWait: No output in the terminal is normal. Just keep the terminal window open.

dialog.title: Disable future workspace guides?
dialog.body: This guide will no longer appear for this or any future workspace you create. You can still initialize a workspace through the Chief entry at the top of the platform.

setup.stepWait: Run the command and wait for it to come online
setup.waitingOnline: Waiting for the executor to come online
setup.pasteHint: Open a terminal on the computer or server running the executor, paste and run the command, and keep it running. The guide continues once it is online.
setup.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the text above and copy it manually.
setup.commandMissing: No launch command has been generated in this session. Generate it again before running.
setup.commandMissingConfigured: A configured executor is offline. Regenerate the launch command and restart it on the machine that runs the executor.
setup.commandRunningHint: Already running it? The guide continues once the executor is online; you can leave this page.
setup.waitExpired: The executor is not online yet. Bring it back online and retry, or skip for now.
setup.actionFailed: The action did not succeed. Retry; you stay on this step.

prompt.initial: Please initialize the current workspace and guide me through the configuration required for software delivery.

draftBlocked: An existing draft was left untouched. Send or clear it, then retry.
capabilityMissing: Workspace initialization is not available yet, so it cannot be handed off. Retry later.
sendFailed: Sending failed. Your draft is kept; retry when ready.
reserveFailed: Could not prepare the initialization conversation. Retry.
advanceFailed: Could not save the guide progress. Refresh and try again.
conflict: The guide progress changed and the latest state is shown.
skipFailed: Could not save the skip preference. Retry.
disableFailed: Saving the preference failed. Retry; the guide stays open.
prefReadFailed: Could not read the workspace guide preference, so the guide is hidden.
loadFailed: Could not load the workspace guide.
